title: The Thief and the Devil
logline: A thief who wants a cow and a devil who wants its owner sneak into the same hut, argue over who goes first, and wake the victim themselves.
moral: When wrongdoers quarrel, the innocent are saved: the intruders were one step from success and their own dispute undid them.
tone: Night-time comic caper played in whispers: tiptoe suspense, mirrored double-act comedy, a loud farcical burst, then a warm quiet ending. The devil is a vain comic imp, never frightening.

beats.summary: An ascetic gets a milking cow and leads her home at dusk.
He daydreams of milk every day: innocent and likeable.
A thief sees the cow and decides to follow and steal her once the man sleeps.
A devil is following too, and he wants the man himself.
Thief and devil meet nose to nose behind the same bush.
Different prizes, no conflict: they agree to wait for the lamp to go out.
The ascetic sleeps; the sleep meter fills; the intruders slip in.
Each is one step from his prize when he sees the other about to act.
They quarrel over who goes first.
The devil argues: the cow will wake and make a noise.
The thief argues the mirror case: the man will wake.
Their voices grow louder; neither gives way.
The thief wakes the victim himself and denounces the devil.
The devil shouts too and denounces the thief.
The ascetic opens his eyes and jumps up.
Neighbours arrive; thief and devil flee with nothing.
The ascetic stays home with the cow beside him.
They were close to success, but their quarrel saved the man.

cast.name: the thief

cast.name: the devil

subtitles.ar: حصل ناسك على بقرة حلوب، وقادها إلى بيته في المساء.|كان يتخيل كيف سيشرب من لبنها كل يوم.|لكن لصًا رآه في الطريق|وقرر أن يتبعه ليسرق البقرة عندما ينام.
subtitles.en: An ascetic received a milking cow and led it home in the evening.|He imagined drinking its milk every day.|But a thief saw him on the road|and decided to follow him and steal the cow after he fell asleep.

subtitles.ar: في الوقت نفسه، كان شيطان يتبع الناسك أيضًا.|لم يكن يريد البقرة، بل أراد أن يخطف الرجل وهو نائم.|التقى الشيطان باللص قرب البيت،|وسأله كل واحد منهما عن سبب وجوده.
subtitles.en: At the same time a devil was also following the ascetic.|He did not want the cow; he intended to abduct the sleeping man.|The devil met the thief near the house,|and each asked the other why he was there.

subtitles.ar: قال اللص: «سآخذ البقرة عندما ينام صاحبها.»|وقال الشيطان: «وأنا سأخطف الرجل نفسه.»|رأى الاثنان أن الوقت مناسب،|فاتفقا على الانتظار حتى يطفئ الناسك المصباح ويستريح.
subtitles.en: “I will take the cow after her owner sleeps,” said the thief.|“And I will take the man himself,” said the devil.|Both thought the moment was right,|so they agreed to wait until the ascetic put out the lamp and rested.

subtitles.ar: دخل الناسك بيته، وربط البقرة في زاوية،|وتناول عشاءه ثم نام.|تسلل اللص والشيطان إلى الداخل.|لكن قبل أن يتحرك أحدهما، بدأ بينهما خلاف حول من يبدأ أولًا.
subtitles.en: The ascetic went inside, tied the cow in a corner,|ate his supper, and fell asleep.|The thief and the devil slipped in.|But before either moved, they began arguing over who should go first.

subtitles.ar: قال الشيطان: «دعني أخطف الرجل أولًا.|إن أخذت البقرة قبلي فقد تستيقظ وتصدر صوتًا،|فينهض الناسك ولا أستطيع أخذه.»|لكن اللص رفض أن ينتظر.
subtitles.en: The devil said, “Let me take the man first.|If you take the cow before me, she may wake up and make a noise.|Then the ascetic will rise, and I cannot take him.”|But the thief refused to wait.

subtitles.ar: رد اللص: «بل دعني أسرق البقرة أولًا!|إذا حاولت خطف الرجل فربما يستيقظ،|وعندها لن أستطيع الخروج بالبقرة.»|ارتفع صوتاهما شيئًا فشيئًا، ولم يرضَ أي منهما بالتراجع.
subtitles.en: The thief replied, “No, let me steal the cow first!|If you try to abduct the man, he may wake up.|Then I cannot leave with the cow.”|Their voices grew louder, and neither would give way.

subtitles.ar: وفجأة صرخ اللص: «أيها الناسك، استيقظ!|هناك شيطان يريد خطفك!»|فصرخ الشيطان أيضًا: «استيقظ! هذا لص يريد سرقة بقرتك!»|سمع الناسك الصياح، ففتح عينيه ونهض بسرعة.
subtitles.en: Suddenly the thief shouted, “Ascetic, wake up!|A devil wants to abduct you!”|The devil shouted too, “Wake up! This is a thief trying to steal your cow!”|The ascetic heard the yelling, opened his eyes, and jumped up.

subtitles.ar: جاء الجيران بعدما سمعوا الضجة،|فهرب اللص والشيطان دون أن يأخذا شيئًا.|بقي الناسك في بيته وبقرته إلى جانبه.|كان الاثنان قد اقتربا من النجاح، لكن خلافهما أنقذ الرجل.
subtitles.en: The neighbors came when they heard the commotion,|and the thief and the devil fled empty-handed.|The ascetic stayed in his home with his cow beside him.|Both intruders had been close to success, but their quarrel saved the man.

new_assets.name: cow
new_assets.description: Comic milking cow for this and any farm or village story. About 330 wide x 230 tall at s 1, feet at (x, y). Pose fields: ph, amp (walk), headDown 0..1 (graze, drink), headTurn -1..1, chew, talk (moo), ears -1..1, tailSwish, lie 0..1 (legs folded under, belly on the ground, 120 tall), bell (angle), eyes (open, shut, wide), brow, plus the shared acting fields.
new_assets.implementation: Copy the Library deer structure (four legs driven by ph/amp, neck and head group). Body: rounded rectangle 220 x 120 in white with three flat black patches clipped to it and blue Ben-Day shading under the belly; legs 16 wide x 90 long with black hooves; pink udder ellipse 50 x 34 under the rear belly with three teats; head box 80 x 70 with a pink muzzle 60 x 40 and two nostrils, eyes through eye2/EYE so gaze, lid and wet work; yellow crescent horns 26 long; leaf ears; tail as a 2-segment rope with a black tuft using swing(); red collar with a yellow bell r 12 that swings with swing(). lie blends leg length to 0 and lowers the body. Wrap with acting() and add a registry entry.

new_assets.name: person costume presets (devil)
new_assets.description: A devil / jinn / ifrit preset for the planned person costume layer, so later tales can reuse it with another palette. Red skin, two horns, pointed ears, goatee and curled moustache, black cape with yellow lining, arrow tail. Extra fields: tailCurl -1..1, tailHold (tail tip held in a hand), capeLag, steam 0..1.
new_assets.implementation: On the person body: skin colour C.red with a darker red dot shade; horns as two yellow triangles 22 high with black outline on the head top; ears as small triangles; goatee triangle and a moustache of two curled strokes in black. Cape: a black quad from the shoulders to knee height drawn behind the torso, its lower corners offset by capeLag (use a lag of the x velocity), yellow strip inside the edge. Tail: a 3-point bezier from the hip, 110 long, 6 wide, ending in a 20 px spade, curl from tailCurl, follow-through with swing(). Steam: two small cloudFlat puffs rising from the ears.

new_assets.name: iconBalloon
new_assets.description: A speech or thought balloon that shows pictograms instead of words, for wordless dialogue: single icon mode (about 170 x 130 px) and strip mode (three frames of about 230 x 170 px across the top of the panel, revealed one by one). Icons needed: cow, ascetic (turban and beard), thief (mask), devil (horns), sack, rope hand, moon with Z Z Z, lamp, doorway; options: cross (red X stamp), badge (1ST), a short word such as MOO! inside a frame.
new_assets.implementation: Draw with the style box primitive plus a tail triangle toward the speaker head. Each icon is a 60 to 90 px flat pictogram function (reuse heads of the real cast at s 0.3 where that is simpler). Strip mode: three boxes with a frame index k and a reveal 0..1 per frame using K.beat pop-in. Place with a clear-of-faces rule: always above and on the outer side of the speaker.

owner_questions: The devil is drawn as a comic red imp with small horns, a cape and an arrow tail (default); say if a darker shadow figure or another look is preferred.
The devil carries an empty sack to show his plan to carry off the man; it is not in the script (default: keep).
A SLEEP meter (10 to 0, AWAKE) is added on screen from 72 s to 145 s to make the rising voices dangerous (default: keep).
A 1ST rosette that the two fight over and tear is an invented visual for "who goes first" (default: keep).

While the two meet and talk near the house (33-63 s) the ascetic is shown still outside watering the cow, and he goes indoors under a "THAT NIGHT..." card at 63 s, because the script has him enter the house only in paragraph 4 (default: this order).
The thief escapes through the window and the devil vanishes in a puff; nobody is hit or caught (default: no violence).

Invented English lettering: ?!, YOU?!, Z Z Z, ME FIRST!, NO, ME!, ME!!, MOO!, WAKE UP! (twice), AAH!, POOF!, plus labels MILKING COW, HOME, THIEF, DEVIL, TIED, EMPTY, STILL TIED, STOLEN: 0, SO CLOSE (default: keep all).
The epilogue gag after THE END shows the two still quarrelling far away on the road (default: keep).
implementation_notes: Start from Library/template. Three scene files are enough: road (S1-S3), yard (S4-S6), hut (S7-S15).
All cue times are word starts from timeline.json; build CUE tables with w(p, n) and check them against the times in this plan.

Hut geography is fixed for the whole second half: door left wall, stool x 430, mat x 440..700 (sleeping head at x 460, face up, toward the camera), peg (860, 700), cow at x 780 facing left, window x 480..580 y 420..520. Argument spot x 330.
Dark room: faces must stay readable. Keep full-colour characters and darken only the set (navy multiply) with a pale blue rim side toward the window; check with stills at 76, 90 and 120 s.
Draw order for hiding: actor first, then tree trunk, milestone or bush. Do not use clipped second copies.

Every character has a gaze target at all times. The cow always looks at whichever intruder moved last; use gazePlan for her as a running gag. Set LIFE.t = t for blinks; explicit lids on the sleeper (lid 1) and in held shocks (noBlink).

The thief and the devil must never move in unison except for the three deliberate mirror moments (34.6 head turn, 53.8 look at the house, 58.1 sitting down); otherwise offset them by 2 to 6 frames with stagger.
Whisper scale: balloon lettering 36 px in S8, lettering 48, 64, 84 px in S11, bursts of about 110 px for WAKE UP!. The growth in size is the storytelling of "louder and louder".

iconBalloon strips sit at panel y 70..250; nothing else may be placed there in S9-S10. The sleepMeter sits above the strips at y 60..100 in S11-S13 when the strips are gone; in S9-S10 move the meter to the top left corner.
Sound: effects only at 6.4, 15.6, 21.3, 63.2, 69.4, 91.0, 109.3 and 166.9 (all inside pauses), master 0.6. The shouting scene has no effects on purpose: the narrator carries it.
Close-up of the sleeping face (139.5-143.6): draw the person head upright at s 3.2 in its own camera, not the lying figure enlarged.
End the frame with S.finish; panel-only shake at 119.7 and 128.8 (3 to 4 px, 0.25 s).
After approval move cow, the devil preset, iconBalloon, firstBadge and the sneak option into Library with registry entries, then run node Library/tests/regression.mjs.
warnings: This plan depends on several assets planned by other stories that are not in Library yet (costume layer, countryRoad, villageYard, hutRoom, thoughtCloud, dayCycle, lampLight, sleepMeter, inset circle, person lie and sit). If KD-026 is built before them, they must be built here to the planned specifications.
Set coordinates for countryRoad, villageYard and hutRoom are requirements, not measurements: the sets do not exist yet. Measure on the sets once built and adjust positions.
The dark interior runs for about 70 s (72-145 s). There is a real risk of a murky, low-contrast picture on a phone; test stills early.
Long static location (S7-S15 in one room, about 106 s). Variety must come from shot sizes, the picture strips, the meter and the acting; do not let the wide shot run for more than 8 s at a time.
The time of paragraph 7 word 3 (126.86) is interpolated, not recognised; do not hang a sharp action on that word.
The narration has no pause between 123.66 and 145.14 or after 109.64, so the loud scene has no sound effects at all.
